title: On complex structures and uniqueness of algebra norms in Banach spaces
summary: For $X$ an infinite dimensional Banach space, we contribute to the study of the Banach algebra $L(X)/S(X)$, where $S(X)$ is the ideal of strictly singular operators. We extend results of Ferenczi-Galego (2007) by proving that $\|I-J\|_S \geq 2$, whenever $I$ is a complex structure on a real space $X$ and $J$ extends a complex structure on a hyperplane of $X$, and where $\|.\|_S$ denotes a certain algebra norm on $L(X)/S(X)$ dominated by the usual quotient norm $\|.\|$.
